expectedFacts.privacy: Allowlist all public response fields and reject values/keys containing any private fixture title, body, attendee, location, calendar/event ID, busy source or raw busy interval. Public ceiling SLOTS, not BUSY.

expectedFacts.race: Exactly one contender confirms in this otherwise free fixture, and at most one incompatible EVENT settles. A loser may lose at hold or confirm; require a typed slot_taken/alternatives or real refusal, never count two success-shaped quarantined responses as bookings.
expectedFacts.writer: Owner calendar, booking heads and effect receipts show one confirmed EVENT; no live hold row fabricated for a contender rejected at hold. All alternatives are offerable fixture slots and disclose no internals.

expectedFacts.orderedHistory: Confirm < reschedule < cancel in receipt/history order, not by assuming wall timestamps are distinct. Earlier versions stay addressable.
